company.name: eDoctor Software
company.shortDescription: eDoctor enables health ministries, hospitals, and medical service providers to increase digitization & automation for more patient centric
company.description:
Overview:
eDoctor is an Egyptian company established in 2018. We’re in the age of Big Data where masses of data are the heart of everything, and the effective management of data will ultimately mean better operational & financial management. Being solution-oriented; we decided to create the change we want to see in the healthcare world by bringing a world-class health information management solution with locally competitive prices to help the healthcare providers digitize their information processes, harness their assets, increase their revenue and join us in transforming the healthcare experience.

Mission:
Improve the lives of patients by serving them better holistically

Vision:
Digitize and organize the health care industry to make it more data based

Products and Services:
National Health: We offer innovative healthcare solutions for developing countries. Our platform acts as an exchange layer for national health records, featuring a country-level portals to digitize healthcare services and centralize data from nationwide facilities into a unified data warehouse. It includes an intuitive command and control dashboard center.
Hospital Information Management System (HIMS): A comprehensive solution that digitizes patient records, manages hospital operations, and integrates various healthcare services. Our tools are secure, user-friendly, and ensure privacy and efficiency in clinic data management.
Patient Care Transformation: Innovative solutions to enhance the patient care experience, from appointment scheduling to post-treatment follow-ups.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $533,000, or 75.82% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,154,102 to $3,475,177, a 3.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
